facts.fact: The Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia states that members of the multidisciplinary working group following the crop campaign (INM and four agriculture and water directorates) were trained by AGRHYMET on 11-15 August 2026 in satellite imagery, rainfall products, NDVI and yield simulation, to monitor rain and crop state and improve the group's bulletin.
facts.system: Grupo de Trabalho Pluridisciplinar (GTP) crop campaign monitoring

GNB.note: Training mentions INM staff but no satellite receiving station or use in forecasts is stated.
